_comment: TEMPORARY setup policy. Attach to the operator identity that runs the SES
Phase 0 commands (see ~/.claude/plans/ses-migration.md), then DETACH once the
identity is verified and the configuration set exists. This is not a runtime
policy - the app only needs iam-policy-erp-app-runtime-ses.json.
Account 157320387454, region ap-south-1. The identity is the ROOT domain
mcaffeine.com, because mail is sent from erp.prefg@mcaffeine.com. A domain
identity (not an email identity) is required so DKIM signing works - DKIM is
what produces DMARC alignment here, since SES's default envelope sender is a
subdomain of amazonses.com and therefore does NOT align with mcaffeine.com on
SESv2 API actions use the 'ses:' prefix, not 'sesv2:'.

Statement._comment: These have no resource to scope to. PutAccountDetails is the production-access request.

Needed to exercise the simulator addresses (bounce@/complaint@/ooto@simulator.amazonses.com) during Phase 2 verification. Both identity ARNs are listed because SES authorises against the address-level ARN before a domain identity exists and the domain-level ARN afterwards. SendRawEmail is required alongside SendEmail for any send carrying raw MIME - see iam-policy-erp-app-runtime-ses.json for why.
